title: Olde Village Mill

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Olde Village Mill offers your business a distinctive venue for corporate gatherings, meetings, and company celebrations in Strasburg, Pennsylvania. Our restored historic mill offers indoor and outdoor event spaces that help create a professional atmosphere while still feeling welcoming and comfortable for your guests. Companies throughout Lancaster County and the surrounding region use our venue for client events, employee gatherings, holiday parties, presentations, and team functions. With on-site parking, flexible layouts, and adaptable event spaces, your business can organize events that feel polished and well-coordinated without the limitations of a traditional conference setting.
